## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasVideoPlayerElement> CreateVideoPlayer( const std::string& identifier, long x, long y, long w, long h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasVideoPlayerElement> CreateVideoPlayerFromFile( const std::string& identifier, long x, long y, long w, long h, const std::string& filePath);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasVideoPlayerElement(const std::string& identifier = "VideoPlayer", long x = 0, long y = 0, long w = 640, long h = 400);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onPlay` | `std::function<void()> onPlay` | _Play_ |
| `onPause` | `std::function<void()> onPause` | _Pause_ |
| `onStop` | `std::function<void()> onStop` | _Stop_ |
| `onSeek` | `std::function<void(double)> onSeek` | _Seek_ |
| `onEnded` | `std::function<void()> onEnded` | _Ended_ |
| `onFileOpened` | `std::function<void(const std::string& filePath)> onFileOpened` | _File opened_ |
| `onOpenCancelled` | `std::function<void()> onOpenCancelled` | _Open cancelled_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
